plain.li: Feeling poorly today. Went to bed early.
Not myself today. Did half the work and felt twice as tired.
Under the weather. I'll be fine in a few days, but today was long.
[ail:HeadCold] Woke up with a stuffed nose and a throat like sandpaper. Half the dining room is sniffling.
[ail:HeadCold] Sneezed into the soup by accident. I made sure it was my own bowl.
[ail:HeadCold,child] I have a cold. My nose is red from wiping it.
[ail:StomachBug] Spent the night running to the latrine. I can't look at food.
[ail:StomachBug] Stomach bug. Kept some water down by evening, which felt like a victory.
[ail:ChestCold] The cold has gone to my chest. I cough every time I laugh, so I've stopped laughing.
[ail:ChestCold,winter] A cough that rattles, and snow up to the knees. This winter and I are not getting along.
[ail:HayFever] The flowers are lovely and they're trying to kill me. Sneezed eleven times before breakfast.
[ail:HayFever] My eyes won't stop watering. Someone asked if I'd been crying.
[ail:Pinkeye] Woke up with my eyelids stuck shut. Pinkeye. I'm washing my hands every hour now.
[ail:Dreamfever] Dreamt the storeroom had a second floor. I went looking for the stairs before I was properly awake.
[ail:Dreamfever] The dreams won't let go of me in the morning. I asked someone about a conversation we never had.
[ail:StrainedBack] Lifted one load too many. My back went, and I had to sit down in the dirt.
[ail:StrainedBack,old] My back isn't what it was. One stone too many today.
[ail:SoreHands] My hands ache from the bench. I couldn't close my fist around a cup tonight.
[ail:Blisters] Blisters on both heels. I walked the last stretch on the sides of my feet.
[ail:Chilblains] My toes itch like mad after the cold. Sat on my hands at dinner to stop scratching.
[ail:Sunburn] Burned my neck and the backs of my arms. I should have worn a hat.
[ail:Sunburn,child] I got sunburned. My nose is peeling.
[ail:SmokeCough] Too long in that smoky room. My throat feels scraped.
[ail:Toothache] A tooth on the left side is throbbing. Chewing on the right.
[ail:Toothache] Toothache. I'm going to have to let someone look at it, and I'm not looking forward to it.
[ail:StiffNeck] Slept wrong. I can only look left by turning my whole body.
[ail:SprainedAnkle] Turned my ankle on the rough ground. It swelled up before I got home.
[ail:EyeStrain] Too long squinting in the dark. My head is pounding.
[ail:RimrotCough] There's a cough in my chest that smells like the walls. That room is damp.
[ail:AshLung] Coughed up gray all evening after the fire.
[ail:Insomnia] Lay awake till the birds started. Counted the roof beams twice.
[ail:Insomnia] Third night running I've heard the night watch change. My eyes feel like sand.
[ail:Migraine] A headache like a nail behind my left eye. Spent the afternoon in the dark with a wet cloth.
[ail:Migraine] Skipped lunch and paid for it. The light hurt so much I worked with my eyes half shut.
[ail:Heartburn] Ate too well tonight and my chest is burning for it. Worth it, mostly.
[ail:Nosebleed] My nose bled all down my scarf out in the cold. Looked like I'd lost a fight.
[ail:MotionSick] Sick by the side of the trail twice today. The pack animals didn't even slow down.
[ail:MotionSick,child] I was sick on the caravan. Twice.
[ail:Splinter] A splinter the size of a nail in my palm, from that last tree.
[ail:InsectBites] Counted forty bites on one arm before I stopped counting.
[ail:InsectBites] The bugs came out at dusk and found every bit of skin I'd left bare.
[ail:PlantRash] Pulled weeds bare-handed and now my arms are a blistered mess. Something in that row didn't like me.
[ail:Frostnip] Couldn't feel my fingertips by the time I came in. Now they sting, which I'm told is good.
[ail:HeatRash] Little red bumps all over my back from the heat. Slept on top of the blanket.
[ail:ColdSore] Woke up with a cold sore. My own cup for a week.
[ail:Lice] Scratched my head all through dinner until somebody said the word: lice.
[ail:Lice,child] I have lice, so they cut my hair really short.
[ail:AthletesFoot] Between my toes is raw and itchy. Too many days in wet boots.
[ail:Hiccups] One drink and I got the hiccups. Everyone had a cure. None of them worked.

warm.li: Feeling rough, but someone left a cup of something hot by my bed.

cheerful.li: Laid low by something small. Back on my feet in a day or two.

gloomy.li: Of course I'm ill. Why wouldn't I be.

cold.li: Minor illness. My work will be slower for a few days.

plain.li: The doctor's face told me more than the words did.
I'm frightened. I've seen this go badly.
[ail:Tetanus] My jaw is stiff and won't open all the way. I remember that wound. I should have had it seen to.
[ail:Pneumonia] Every breath hurts. They've propped me up on pillows so I can get the air in.
[ail:Tuberculosis] Coughed blood into my hand this morning. I knew before anyone told me.
[ail:Tuberculosis] They've put me in a room by myself. I understand why. It's still lonely.
[ail:Typhus] Burning up, with a headache like a hammer. They say it was the lice.
[ail:Meningitis] The light hurts and my head is splitting. I can barely hold the pen.
[ail:Scurvy] My gums bleed when I eat. They say it's the food, or what's missing from it.
[ail:Glassblood] There's a glitter in my veins. I keep holding my wrists up to the light.
[ail:Cholera] I can't stop drinking and I can't keep any of it in. They say it was the water.
[ail:Cholera] Someone sits by the bed with a cup all night. Sip, wait, sip.
[ail:Appendicitis] The pain moved from my middle to low on my right side. The doctor pressed there and I nearly hit the ceiling.
[ail:Rabies] The animal that bit me was foaming at the mouth. They treat the bite every day now, and I watch the doctor's face each time.
[ail:Measles,child] I have spots everywhere and I'm not allowed to see anyone.
[ail:Measles] Hot and itchy, and my eyes hurt. They keep the curtains closed.
[ail:KidneyStone] Worst pain of my life, and they tell me it's a stone the size of a lentil.
[ail:Shingles] A band of blisters round my ribs. They say it's the chickenpox I had as a child, come back for me.
[ail:HiveFever] The sting has gone hard and hot, and there's a humming in my ears.

warm.li: Whatever happens, they've been good to me here.

blunt.li: It's bad. I'm going to fight it.

cheerful.li: I've been sicker. I think. I'm going to get through this.

gloomy.li: If this is how it ends, I'd like it to be quick.

cold.li: Serious illness. Whether I live depends on the doctor and the medicine stocks.

plain.li: Feeling like myself again.
Ate a full meal today and kept it down. Better.
[serious] I'm through the worst of it. I still can't climb a slope without stopping, but I'm here.
[serious] The fever broke last night. I slept through till morning and woke up hungry.
[ail:Pneumonia] I can breathe again. I keep taking deep breaths just because I can.
[ail:Tetanus] My jaw opens. I ate bread today. Real bread, chewed.
[ail:Tuberculosis] The cough is gone. Weeks of treatment, every single day. I owe the doctor more than I can say.
[ail:Typhus] The rash has faded and I can think straight. I don't remember most of last week.
[ail:Meningitis] I can look at the sun again without wincing. My legs are still weak.
[ail:Scurvy] My gums have stopped bleeding. I never thought I'd be so glad to see a vegetable.
[ail:Glassblood] The glitter has faded from my arms. My knuckles still click when I make a fist.
[ail:HeadCold] The cold's gone. I can taste my food again.
[ail:StrainedBack] Bent down to pick something up without thinking about it. The back's healed.
[ail:SprainedAnkle] Walked without the stick today.
[ail:Toothache] The tooth's dealt with and the ache is gone. Should have had it done a week ago.
[ail:Cholera] Kept down a whole bowl of broth. Then another.
[ail:Appendicitis] The pain in my side has finally gone. The doctor says it walled itself off and I was lucky.
[ail:Rabies] The doctor says the danger has passed. I've looked at that bite every morning for weeks; today I didn't.
[ail:Measles,child] My spots are gone and I'm allowed outside again!
[ail:KidneyStone] It passed. I've never been so glad to see something so small.
[ail:Shingles] The blisters have dried up. My shirt doesn't hurt anymore.
[ail:HiveFever] The humming stopped in the night. I lay awake listening to how quiet it was.
[ail:Insomnia] Slept right through the night, and woke up not knowing where I was.
[ail:Lice] The lice are gone. I still scratch out of habit.

warm.li: Back on my feet. Thank you to everyone who brought me soup.

cheerful.li: Healthy again! It's amazing what a few good nights' sleep can do.

gloomy.li: Better, for now. Until the next thing.

cold.li: Recovered. I lost some days of work.

plain.li: Treated {OTHER_nameDef} today. It should pass.
Saw to {OTHER_nameDef} this afternoon. Told {OTHER_objective} to rest, which {OTHER_pronoun} won't.
[serious] {OTHER_nameDef} is seriously ill. I've done what I can for today. Tomorrow I'll do it again.
[serious] Sat up with {OTHER_nameDef} most of the night. The medicine is going faster than I'd like.
[ail:Tetanus] Cleaned out {OTHER_nameDef}'s old wound again and kept the room dark. The spasms are hard to watch.
[ail:Tuberculosis] Started {OTHER_nameDef} on the long course. Every day for weeks, and no skipping.
[ail:Meningitis] Tended {OTHER_nameDef} twice since noon, and I'll go again at dark. The first day decides it.
[ail:Typhus] Burned {OTHER_nameDef}'s bedding and cut {OTHER_possessive} hair short. The lice first, then the fever.
[ail:Pneumonia] Propped {OTHER_nameDef} up with every pillow we have. {OTHER_nameDef}'s breathing is wet and shallow.
[ail:Toothache] Saw to a bad tooth for {OTHER_nameDef}. I wasn't thanked at the time.
[ail:StrainedBack] Strapped up {OTHER_nameDef}'s back and said to stay in bed. We'll see if that happens.
[ail:SprainedAnkle] Wrapped {OTHER_nameDef}'s ankle and found a stick to lean on.
[ail:Cholera] Sat with {OTHER_nameDef} through the night with a cup of salted water. Sip, wait, sip.
[ail:Appendicitis] Pressed on {OTHER_nameDef}'s belly, low on the right, and {OTHER_nameDef} nearly kicked me. That appendix has to come out.
[ail:Rabies] Washed out {OTHER_nameDef}'s bite again and started the course. Every day now, no exceptions.
[ail:Measles] Drew the curtains for {OTHER_nameDef} and sat until {OTHER_pronoun} fell asleep. The spots are spreading.
[ail:KidneyStone] Gave {OTHER_nameDef} something for the pain and a full jug of water. The stone will pass.
[ail:Shingles] Dressed the blisters round {OTHER_nameDef}'s ribs. {OTHER_nameDef} winced at every touch.
[ail:HiveFever] Opened the swelling on {OTHER_nameDef}'s sting and drained it. The fever's high.
[ail:Splinter] Picked a splinter out of {OTHER_nameDef}'s palm. It was longer than either of us expected.
[ail:Lice] Went through {OTHER_nameDef}'s hair with a fine comb for an hour. Then I boiled the comb.
[ail:Migraine] Drew the curtains for {OTHER_nameDef} and asked everyone to keep their voices down.

warm.li: Looked after {OTHER_nameDef} today. I like being useful.

cheerful.li: Patched up {OTHER_nameDef}. Good as new in a few days.

gloomy.li: Another patient. {OTHER_nameDef} this time. There's always another.

cold.li: Treated {OTHER_nameDef}. One more dose gone from the shelf.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is going to live. I sat down on the step outside and didn't get up for a while.
{OTHER_nameDef} walked to the dining room today. Some nights I wasn't sure {OTHER_pronoun} would.
[ail:Rabies] {OTHER_nameDef}'s bite has healed and the danger has passed. Every day for weeks, and it worked.
[ail:Cholera] {OTHER_nameDef} asked for real food today. I had to go outside for a minute.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} thanked me today. I didn't know what to say, so I said to finish the soup.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made it! Best news in a long time.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} lived. This time it went our way.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} survived. The treatment worked as it should.

plain.li: Lost {OTHER_nameDef} today. I keep going over what I could have done.
I did everything I knew for {OTHER_nameDef}. It wasn't enough.
[ail:Rabies] We were too late with {OTHER_nameDef}. Once the fever came, all I could do was sit with {OTHER_objective}.

warm.li: I held {OTHER_nameDef}'s hand at the end. I hope that counted for something.

cheerful.li: I'll remember {OTHER_nameDef} laughing at the table, not the last days.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is gone. Sometimes medicine isn't enough.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died of the illness. I'll need better medicine for the next one.
